  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索器升级评估依赖聚合指标，可能掩盖原本已被正确服务的查询出现回退。论文旨在量化这种负面翻转，理解其随语料库、检索器、检索深度的变化，并探索缓解方案，推动更细粒度的评估方法。

Method: 在三个BEIR集合（Natural Questions、HotpotQA、FiQA）上，对比BM25与三种密集检索器（BGE-large、E5-large-v2、SPLADE）在五个检索深度下的表现。定义负面翻转为BM25检索到判定相关段落而替代检索器未检索到的查询。使用any-relevant支持标签，并在HotpotQA上进一步要求每个正qrel段落均被覆盖。尝试固定预算结合BM25的简单融合，并进行HotpotQA阅读器下游实验验证答案层面影响。

Result: 所有替代检索器提升整体召回覆盖，但负面翻转普遍存在且显著差异：k=1时BM25成功查询的8.6-37.5%丢失；随深度增加翻转率下降；HotpotQA k=10要求全正例覆盖时翻转率升至12.3-17.3%。BM25固定预算融合有效降低回退；阅读器实验显示部分检索翻转伴随答案退化。

Conclusion: 检索器更新评估不应仅依赖聚合检索质量指标，必须引入查询级兼容性分析，以识别和缓解对已正确服务查询的回退。简单融合BM25可作为实用缓解策略。

Abstract: Retriever upgrades are typically evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide regressions on queries the previous retriever already served correctly. We study these regressions as negative flips: queries for which BM25 retrieves a judged relevant passage and the replacement does not. We evaluate BGE-large, E5-large-v2, and SPLADE on three BEIR collections: Natural Questions, HotpotQA, and FiQA, across five retrieval depths. All replacements improve overall retrieval coverage. Negative flips occur in every setting and vary substantially by corpus, retriever, and depth. At k=1, 8.6-37.5% of BM25 successes are lost across the evaluated settings. Negative-flip rates are lower in the larger-depth settings, where the BM25-supported cohort is defined separately at each depth. These rates use the any-relevant support label. On HotpotQA at k=10, requiring every positive qrel passage raises the negative-flip rate to 12.3-17.3%. Simple fixed-budget combinations with BM25 reduce these regressions, and a HotpotQA reader experiment provides a limited downstream check in which some retrieval flips are accompanied by answer regressions. These results motivate evaluating retriever updates using query-level compatibility alongside aggregate retrieval quality.

</details>


### [82] [Rethinking Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation: SimHash with Parallel Decoding and Semantic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07402)
*Yuqing Liu,Huiyuan Chen,Yibo Wang,Wooseong Yang,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文挑战了生成式推荐中基于哈希的语义ID（如SimHash）劣于复杂学习量化的共识，指出性能差距源于自回归解码的结构不匹配和离散化信息损失。提出FLASH框架，通过并行解码和显式语义对齐复活免训练的SimHash，在多个数据集上达到SOTA，且在冷启动场景泛化更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法多采用复杂的学习型量化构建语义ID，而简单的哈希方法（如SimHash）被认为根本较差。作者发现性能差距并非哈希固有局限，而是源于与自回归解码的结构不匹配及刚性离散化导致的信息损失。

Method: 提出FLASH两阶段框架：第一阶段使用免训练的SimHash生成语义ID；第二阶段通过并行解码和显式语义对齐机制，弥合哈希表示与生成模型之间的差距，无需训练分词器。

Result: FLASH在多个基准数据集上达到最先进性能，且完全免去分词器训练；在冷启动场景展现更强泛化能力；语义对齐机制被证明在多种范式中普遍有效。

Conclusion: 配合兼容的解码策略和语义 grounding，简单高效的免训练分词器（如SimHash）可达到与复杂学习型分词器相当的生成式推荐性能，打破了‘复杂优于简单’的固有认知。

Abstract: Semantic ID-based generative recommendation represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens, enabling structured modeling of item semantics. A critical challenge is constructing semantic IDs that are both semantically expressive and computationally efficient. While recent approaches favor complex learned quantization, simple hashing-based methods such as SimHash are widely regarded as fundamentally inferior. In this work, we challenge this consensus by showing that the apparent performance gap does not stem from inherent limitations of hashing, but rather from a structural mismatch with autoregressive decoding, coupled with the inevitable information loss during rigid discretization. Based on this insight, we propose FLASH, a two-stage framework that revitalizes training-free SimHash tokenization through parallel decoding and explicit semantic alignment. Despite its simplicity, FLASH achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple datasets without requiring any tokenizer training, while exhibiting stronger generalization in cold-start scenarios. Notably, we demonstrate that semantic alignment acts as a universally effective mechanism across diverse paradigms. Our findings suggest that, with compatible decoding and semantic grounding, simple and efficient tokenizers can achieve performance comparable to complex learned counterparts in generative recommendation. Our code is available at https://github.com/KevinC2015/Flash.

</details>


### [83] [A Study of Prior Case Retrieval Using Lexical, Semantic, and Rhetorical Role Information in Indian Legal Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07437)
*Sayed Ayaan Ahmed Sha,Sangeetha Sivanesan,Anand Kumar Madasamy,Navya Binu,Aniket Mani,Rishu Kumar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对印度法律判决中的先例检索任务（IL PCR），通过实证评估三代检索系统设计，发现修辞角色组合优于单一角色或全文检索，法条相似性无判别力，且基于LLM生成数据的法律蕴含重排器在官方评测中表现远差于内部验证。最终提出查询不相交切分与冻结验证融合的四阶段流水线，取得Micro F1 0.2549、MRR 0.6081、nDCG@10 0.4187的官方指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度法律先例检索面临核心挑战：仅凭法条共享无法判定相关性，需从词汇相似性中分离出真正的法律事实。现有方法在内部验证与官方评测间存在巨大鸿沟，亟需一种能泛化到未见查询的鲁棒检索框架。

Method: 1. 实证对比三代检索系统：全文检索、单一修辞角色检索、多角色组合检索（Fact、Ratio、Precedent、Argument、Statute）。2. 引入法律蕴含重排器，但发现LLM生成的训练数据导致官方评测失效。3. 提出新设计：查询不相交切分以消除数据泄露，冻结验证融合以稳定模型选择。4. 构建四阶段流水线：初检、重排、融合、最终排序。

Result: 多修辞角色组合显著优于基线；法条相似性无判别力；两个内部MRR高达0.97的重排器在官方评测中MRR跌至0.14。最终四阶段流水线在官方测试集达到Micro F1 0.2549、MRR 0.6081、nDCG@10 0.4187。

Conclusion: 先例检索需显式建模法律修辞结构而非依赖表层法条匹配；内部验证指标不可靠，必须采用查询级不相交切分与冻结验证策略以缩小验证-测试鸿沟。四阶段流水线实现了目前最佳的官方评测性能。

Abstract: For retrieving prior cases in Indian legal judgments, the problem involves distinguishing relevant legal facts from mere lexical similarities because a prior case that shares a statute with the query judgment is not necessarily relevant. In this paper, we describe an empirical evaluation of three consecutive designs of retrieval systems for the IL PCR(Indian Legal Prior Case Retrieval) task. We demonstrate that the combination of the rhetorical roles (Fact, Ratio Of The Decision, Precedent, Argument, Statute) is better than either using individual roles or performing full text retrieval, that statute similarity is not discriminative, and that a legal entailment reranker with training data produced by an LLM is much worse in terms of official evaluation than its internal validation score. Two rankers, with excellent internal MRR up to 0.97, performed poorly in terms of official evaluation (MRR as low as 0.14). Thus, we propose a new design with query disjoint splitting and frozen validation fusion. The result is a four stage pipeline with Micro F1 0.2549, MRR 0.6081, and nDCG@10 0.4187.

</details>


### [84] [DBRAG: Multi-Table Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Database Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07622)
*Prince Larbi Ampofo,Ryoji Kubo,Djellel Difallah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出DBRAG，一个面向多表问答的检索增强生成框架，通过离线表索引检索候选表、用查询相关行丰富表摘要、LLM重排、程序辅助推理器选择并操作表，显著提升多表检索与问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型处理结构化数据的方法多局限于单表场景或假设已给出相关表，但实际用户常在整个数据库上发起复杂探索查询，相关信息分散在多个关系表中，缺乏有效的多表检索与推理机制。

Method: DBRAG包含三阶段：1) 离线构建表索引，检索候选表；2) 用查询相关行丰富表摘要，经LLM重排；3) 程序辅助推理器选取所需表并对全量内容执行操作，保持提示上下文精简。

Result: 在Spider、GeoQuery和ATIS数据集上，DBRAG在表检索和多表问答任务上均取得性能提升。

Conclusion: DBRAG通过检索增强与程序辅助推理相结合，有效解决了跨多表的复杂数据探索问答问题，为数据库自然语言接口提供了实用框架。

Abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have introduced new capabilities for reasoning over structured data, particularly through program-aided tools that can analyze tables. However, many existing methods address single-table scenarios or assume that the relevant tables are already provided. In practice, users often issue complex data exploration queries over entire databases, where relevant information may be distributed across multiple relations. In this work, we introduce DBRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework tailored for multi-table question answering. DBRAG first retrieves candidate tables using an offline table index, enriches their summaries with query-relevant rows, and uses an LLM to rerank the candidates. A program-aided reasoner then selects the required tables and executes operations over their full contents, keeping the initial prompt context compact. Experiments on the Spider, GeoQuery, and ATIS datasets used in this study demonstrate improvements in table retrieval and multi-table question answering.

</details>


### [85] [Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07731)
*Qi Liu,Fengming Liang,Yiqun Chen,Erhan Zhang,Jiaxin Mao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RELER（REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval），一种基于强化学习的框架，使现有嵌入模型能直接在嵌入空间中学习检索并对齐任务特定奖励。通过从von Mises-Fisher分布采样嵌入动作，结合条件均值投影（CMP）降低高维探索噪声，并使用留一法基线（RLOO）更新编码器。实验表明，在BRIGHT基准及七个问答数据集的RAG场景下，RELER显著优于InfoNCE和LambdaLoss，提升了检索指标和下游生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密检索模型通常采用对比学习目标（如InfoNCE）训练，虽能学习有效表示，但未直接优化检索指标（如nDCG）或下游任务性能，导致检索效果与实际任务需求存在差距。

Method: RELER框架：1) 将归一化编码器输出作为vMF分布的中心，采样单位长度的查询和文档嵌入动作；2) 以检索结果或下游任务结果为奖励；3) 采用REINFORCE算法结合留一法基线（RLOO）更新编码器；4) 提出条件均值投影（CMP），将采样嵌入投影到由编码器输出与候选嵌入张成的低维子空间，减少策略梯度噪声并保持期望不变。

Result: 在BRIGHT推理密集型基准上，对BGE-M3和Qwen3-Embedding骨干进行后训练，RELER在平均nDCG@10上持续超越InfoNCE和LambdaLoss。在RAG下游评测中，仅微调查询编码器并固定文档索引与生成器，联合优化检索与答案奖励，在七个问答数据集上同时提升了平均检索性能和答案质量。

Conclusion: RELER通过强化学习直接在嵌入空间优化检索策略，结合CMP技术有效解决高维探索噪声，实现了检索指标与下游任务奖励的直接对齐，为稠密检索模型的任务感知式后训练提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanned by its encoder output and the candidate embeddings it is compared against, reducing noise in the policy gradient while preserving its expectation. We evaluate RELER on BRIGHT, a benchmark with reasoning-intensive queries that remain challenging for existing embedding models. RELER consistently outperforms InfoNCE and LambdaLoss in average nDCG@10 when post-training BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding backbones. We further evaluate downstream utility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where we adapt only the query encoder while keeping the document index and generator fixed. Across seven QA datasets, jointly optimizing retrieval and answer rewards improves both average retrieval performance and answer quality in RAG.

</details>


### [86] [Token-Budgeted Escalation for Financial Document QA: Cost Is Predictable, Benefit Is the Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07760)
*Junru Zhu,Yixin Yang,Xiaoqing Ding,Ruoyu Qi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种选择性升级策略，在有限Token预算下为金融文档问答分配额外检索资源，通过预测每个查询的收益与成本比来优先分配，实现在10%预算下提升裁决质量并大幅减少Token使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强生成系统在处理困难查询时可路由到更深层上下文，但在批量部署中需在共享Token预算下分配成本各异的查询，现有方法未充分考虑异质成本与收益的权衡。

Method: 将选择性升级建模为有限批次分配问题。对150个FinanceBench问题先进行top-1检索回答，再训练预测器估计可选top-5调用的裁决质量增益和Token成本，分配器按预测的每Token增益优先级分配预算。

Result: 在10%预算下，基于增益每Token的分配比仅按增益排序提升裁决质量0.034（95% CI [0.001, 0.072]），且比一次性top-5检索减少46.6% Token。额外调用成本可准确预测（R²=0.93），但有益升级的排序仍具挑战（AUROC=0.60）。

Conclusion: 结果表明在紧约束下异质成本可被利用，但要在全预算前沿取得进展，需要更强的查询特定收益估计。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can route difficult queries to deeper context, but batch deployments must allocate a shared token budget across calls whose costs vary by query. We formulate selective escalation as finite-batch allocation for financial document question answering. Each of 150 FinanceBench questions first receives a top-1 retrieval answer. Predictors estimate the adjudication-quality gain and token cost of an optional top-5 call, and the allocator prioritizes calls by predicted gain per token. At the nominal 10% budget, gain-per-token allocation improves adjudication quality over gain-only ranking by 0.034 (95% document-bootstrap CI [0.001, 0.072]) while using 46.6% fewer total tokens than one-pass top-5 retrieval. Additional-call cost is accurately predictable (R-squared 0.93), whereas beneficial escalation remains difficult to rank (AUROC 0.60). These results show that heterogeneous cost is actionable under tight constraints, while progress across the full budget frontier depends on stronger query-specific benefit estimates.

</details>


### [87] [Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07761)
*Emrul Hasan,Chen Ding*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARER 模型，通过对比学习融合评分特征与评论方面特征，同时提升推荐准确性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐模型难以同时兼顾推荐准确性与解释生成质量，亟需一种能从文本评论中学习方面级特征并与评分信息有效融合的方法。

Method: 采用 MLP 学习评分特征，用 Transformer Encoder 编码方面级评论表示并引入对比学习区分用户偏好，最后用 Transformer Decoder 基于融合后的用户/物品表示生成解释。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，CLARER 在推荐精度（如 HR、NDCG）和解释生成质量（如 BLEU、ROUGE）上均显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 融合评分与方面级评论特征并辅以对比学习，能有效提升推荐模型的准确性与可解释性，CLARER 为可解释推荐提供了新范式。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.

</details>


### [88] [From Delivery to Stateful Exploration: Rethinking the Index for Agentic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07960)
*Deogyong Kim,Sunghwan Kim,Sangam Lee,Wonjae Lee,Dongha Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 IndexAct，一种基于倒排索引的语料库交互接口，将候选集细化与文本检视分离，使智能体能通过词条件和集合操作持久化操作候选集，获得候选数量等统计反馈而非匹配片段，从而在多跳问答和智能体搜索基准上超越基线，实现更高证据覆盖率、更小上下文且随语料库扩展保持准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体搜索接口常将候选集细化与源文本暴露耦合：即使仅需候选集反馈即可决策，接口仍返回匹配片段，导致上下文膨胀、状态难以复用，阻碍持续证据发现。

Method: 设计 IndexAct 接口：智能体在倒排索引上构建/操作持久候选集，支持词条件与集合运算（并/差/交），返回可复用的状态引用及候选计数等统计信息；文本检视作为单独操作按需触发，提供线索供后续候选集操作参考。

Result: 在五个涵盖智能体搜索与多跳问答的基准上均优于基线。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，以更小的平均活跃上下文实现更高证据覆盖率，且随语料库扩展答案准确率不降。消融表明：信息丰富的细化反馈与状态复用是性能提升关键，单纯缩短上下文或减少搜索步数不足以保证效果。

Conclusion: IndexAct 通过将候选集细化与文本检视解耦，利用索引原生操作提供可复用的统计反馈，显著提升智能体在大规模语料库上的证据发现效率与答案质量，为智能体搜索系统提供了更可扩展的交互范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic search have given large language model (LLM) agents finer control over corpus exploration. However, search interfaces often return matching passages even when feedback about the candidate set would suffice for the next decision, coupling candidate refinement with source-text exposure. We propose IndexAct, an interface for Index-Native Corpus Interaction that separates candidate-set refinement from text inspection. Agents construct and manipulate persistent candidate sets through lexical conditions and set operations over an inverted index, receiving reusable state references and statistics such as candidate counts rather than matching passages. This feedback guides further refinement, while separately requested passages provide new clues or evidence that can inform subsequent operations on retained candidate sets. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning agentic search and multi-hop question answering show that IndexAct outperforms the evaluated baselines on each benchmark. On BrowseComp-Plus, it also achieves higher evidence coverage with a smaller average live context than terminal-based corpus interfaces, and maintains answer accuracy as the corpus expands. Further analyses suggest that informative refinement feedback and state reuse support continued evidence discovery, while shorter contexts or fewer search steps alone do not ensure better performance.

</details>


### [89] [Adapting Generative Recommenders for Multi-Turn Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08136)
*Yu-Chen Den,Zhi Rui Tam,Yung-Yu Shih,Shih-Hsin Wang,Yun-Nung Chen,Pu-Jen Cheng,Eugene Yang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: INTEGER 将生成式推荐扩展为多轮交互系统，通过学习路由 token 决定推荐时机、历史重锚定融合行为与对话上下文、行为重放与指令数据排练防止遗忘，在保持推荐准确性的同时实现自然对话反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐仅根据历史行为解码物品，无法让用户在对话中纠正偏离当前意图的推荐；直接引入对话训练会覆盖模型依赖的历史到物品映射，导致推荐性能下降。

Method: 提出 INTEGER 框架：1) 学习路由 token，让模型自主决定何时推荐；2) 历史重锚定，使每次推荐同时条件于过往行为与对话历史；3) 行为重放结合指令数据排练，在适应对话任务时防止灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在 Amazon Beauty 和 Toys 数据集上，INTEGER 的 Hit@10 达到或超过最强基线，Beauty 上提升 13.3%；对话质量具有竞争力；消融实验显示其学会在用户意图明确时推荐、保持对行为历史的关注，并学到一种意图无关的物品空间替代机制，能抑制被拒物品。

Conclusion: INTEGER 成功将生成式推荐扩展为交互式多轮系统，在不牺牲推荐准确性的前提下实现自然语言反馈，为后续引入属性感知反馈奠定基础。

Abstract: Generative recommenders decode items from a user's interaction history, but offer no way for users to correct a recommendation that misses their current intent. Adding conversation is natural since items and words share same output space, yet training the model to converse may overwrite the history-to-item mapping it relies on. We introduce INTEGER (**INTE**ractive **GE**nerative **R**ecommendation), which extends generative recommendation to multi-turn interaction with a learned routing token that lets the model decide when to recommend, history re-anchoring that conditions each item on both past behavior and the dialogue, and behavioral replay with instruction-data rehearsal that prevents forgetting during adaptation. Users can thus give feedback on recommendations within the dialogue, while recommendations stay grounded in behavioral history and accuracy is not traded for fluency. On Amazon Beauty and Toys, INTEGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in accuracy with competitive conversation quality, improving Hit@10 by 13.3% on Amazon Beauty, and significantly outperforms the generative recommender it starts from. Our analyses show that INTEGER learns behaviors that naive adaptation fails to acquire, recommending once the user's intent is clear and staying attentive to behavioral history at the moment of recommendation. INTEGER also learns an intent-agnostic replacement over the item space, which suppresses rejected items but points to attribute-aware feedback as the next step.

</details>


### [90] [Behavior-Mining, Generative Conversations, and Collaborative Advisory: the Future of Travel and Tourism Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08232)
*Alejandro Bellogín,Linus W. Dietz,Francesco Ricci,Pablo Sánchez*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文指出旅游推荐系统（TTRSs）尽管研究丰富但未广泛应用，归因于三大局限：数据集陈旧稀疏、算法过度追求预测准确性而忽视新颖性和上下文相关性、未满足旅行者特定需求。生成式AI正成为旅行规划主要入口，迫使TTRSs重新设计：未来系统应成为灵活的决策顾问，整合多模态数据与多种AI技术（数据挖掘到自然语言处理），并透明平衡旅行者、服务商、平台方和社区的多方利益。文章勾勒了结合新旧推荐技术的研究目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管旅游推荐系统研究持久且多面，但TTRSs尚未普及。作者认为三大原因限制了其落地：1）训练验证用数据集陈旧稀疏；2）算法优先预测准确性，忽视新颖性、上下文相关性等领域维度；3）未解决旅行者特定需求。与此同时，生成式AI应用正成为旅行规划的主要入口，颠覆了旅游信息与商业化平台生态，迫使研究重新思考TTRSs的设计与核心技术整合。

Method: 本文采用概念分析与研究议程提出的方法，综述TTRSs现状与局限，结合市场调研中生成式AI的崛起趋势，论证未来TTRSs应具备的特征（灵活顾问、多模态整合、多方利益平衡），并勾勒出结合传统推荐技术与生成式AI的具体研究目标。

Result: 提出未来TTRSs的研究目标：1）从单纯信息过滤转向支持决策的灵活顾问；2）整合多种数据类型与AI技术（数据挖掘、自然语言处理等）；3）透明平衡旅行者、服务供应商、平台所有者、当地社区等多方冲突目标；4）将旧有推荐技术与生成式AI新技术有效结合，构建更有效的TTRSs。

Conclusion: 生成式AI的崛起要求旅游推荐系统范式转型：未来TTRSs须超越个性化过滤，成为融合多模态数据与多元AI技术的决策支持顾问，并在透明机制下平衡多利益相关者目标。通过增量研究解决现有局限，并果断整合生成式AI能力，方能实现TTRSs的广泛落地与长期价值。

Abstract: Since the early adoption of e-commerce, travel and tourism has been a lab for the design of recommender systems: tools that help travelers choose destinations, flights, accommodations, and combine them into itineraries. Data-driven recommendation techniques, ranging from case-based reasoning to reinforcement learning, have been adapted to travelers' needs. The research community has produced multifaceted prototypes of travel and tourism recommender systems (TTRSs), which are context-dependent, multistakeholder-oriented, and more recently, addressing sustainability issues, such as overtourism. Despite this enduring work, TTRSs are not widespread yet. We argue that three limitations can explain this: outdated and sparse data sets used to train and validate TTRSs, algorithms that prioritize prediction accuracy over domain-specific dimensions such as novelty and contextual relevance, and a failure to address the specific needs of travelers. Targeted incremental research could address these limitations, but a disruptive factor has meanwhile entered the ecosystem of tourism information and commercialization platforms: generative artificial intelligence. According to market research, GenAI applications are becoming the primary entry point for travelers planning their trips. This forces research to rethink how TTRSs should be designed and which core techniques should be integrated. We claim that future TTRSs, in addition to offering personalized information filtering, should become more flexible advisors that support decision making, integrating multiple data types and AI techniques, from data mining to natural language processing. Moreover, they must transparently balance the conflicting goals of travelers, service suppliers, platform owners, and local communities. We then outline research targets for building more effective TTRSs, fruitfully combining old and new recommendation techniques.

</details>


### [91] [Aligning Performance with Contribution: Towards Contribution-Aware Fair Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08245)
*Shuai Zhang,Hui Fang,Zun Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出贡献-绩效公平性，一种新颖的推荐系统公平视角，要求推荐绩效与用户对模型学习的估计贡献对齐，并设计CPFR框架实现该目标，在三个数据集和三个主干模型上验证了其准确性-公平性权衡的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统用户公平性研究关注多样目标，但忽视了分布式视角：用户对模型学习的贡献是否应反映在其获得的推荐收益中。作者主张除现有公平保护外，公平系统还应考虑用户估计贡献与推荐绩效的对齐，以激励持续且有信息量的参与，支持可持续推荐生态系统。

Method: 提出贡献-绩效公平推荐器（CPFR），适用于不同主干推荐模型。CPFR基于训练依赖的贡献（交互量、损失对齐、优化强度）构建有序用户群，联合优化推荐准确性与两个公平性要求：群体间贡献-绩效对齐、群体内可比贡献用户的公平性。同时提供博弈论分析证明对齐能强化贡献激励并提升系统级推荐准确性。

Result: 在三个数据集和三个主干模型上的实验表明，CPFR在提出的操作指标下实现了强有力的准确性-公平性权衡。博弈论分析显示该对齐机制可增强用户贡献激励，并在自愿贡献条件下提升系统整体推荐准确性。

Conclusion: 贡献-绩效公平性为推荐系统公平性提供了新的分布式视角，CPFR框架有效实现了贡献与绩效的对齐，既保证了群体间的公平分配又维护了群体内的公平性，为构建可持续的推荐生态系统提供了理论与实践基础。

Abstract: Existing research on user fairness in recommender systems has developed diverse objectives. However, it has paid limited attention to a distinct distributive perspective: whether users' contributions to model learning should be reflected in the recommendation benefits they receive. We argue that, in addition to existing fairness protections, a fair system may account for the alignment between users' estimated contributions and the recommendation performance they receive. Such alignment can incentivize sustained and informative engagement, thereby supporting a sustainable recommendation ecosystem. To this end, we propose Contribution-Performance Fairness, a novel fairness perspective which requires recommendation performance to be aligned with estimated contribution across user groups and to remain equitable among users with comparable contributions within a same group. To instantiate this perspective, we introduce the Contribution-Performance Fair Recommender (CPFR), a framework applicable to different backbone recommenders. CPFR constructs ordered user groups from a training-dependent contribution considering interaction volume, loss alignment, and optimization intensity, and jointly optimizes recommendation accuracy with the two fairness requirements. A game-theoretic analysis shows that such alignment can strengthen contribution incentives and improve system-level recommendation accuracy under voluntary contribution. Experiments on three datasets and three backbone models demonstrate that CPFR achieves a strong accuracy--fairness trade-off under the proposed operational metric.

</details>


### [92] [Seeing the Context: Enhancing Recommender Systems with Image-Derived Contextual Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08407)
*Tal Cordova,Tomer Geva,Moshe Unger*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出从图像中提取情境上下文（物理、社交、模态类别），构建ICE-Fuse流水线融合这些类别并集成到上下文感知推荐系统中，实验表明图像上下文与评论上下文互补，结合能提升推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统主要利用位置、时间、评论作为上下文，多模态推荐系统虽使用图像但主要丰富物品/用户表征，未将图像作为情境上下文。论文旨在探索从图像中学习情境上下文以补充现有信号。

Method: 使用视觉语言模型从图像中学习物理、社交、模态三类上下文类别，提出ICE-Fuse流水线融合这些类别并集成到上下文感知推荐系统中，基于TripAdvisor数据集，采用评论感知图对比学习作为推荐算法进行实验评估。

Result: 单独使用图像上下文不优于已有信号，但结合现有信号时能提升性能，表明互补信息。语义分析显示图像和评论衍生的上下文捕捉互动的不同方面，确立图像作为补充上下文的定位。

Conclusion: 图像可提供与评论不同的情境上下文，作为补充信号融入推荐系统能提升推荐效果，为多模态上下文感知推荐提供新思路。

Abstract: Contextual information, capturing the circumstances of a user-item interaction, is central to recommender systems. Prior work draws context from location, time, or reviews, but not images; multimodal recommender systems mainly use images to enrich item or user representations, not identify situational context. We propose a new representation of context derived from images, spanning physical, social, and modal categories learned via a vision-language model. We introduce ICE-Fuse, a pipeline for evaluating this representation that fuses these categories and integrates them into a context-aware recommender system, using TripAdvisor data and Review-aware Graph Contrastive Learning as the recommendation algorithm. Image context does not outperform established signals standalone, but improves them combined, indicating complementary information. Semantic analysis shows image- and review-derived context capture distinct aspects of the interaction, positioning images as complementary context.

</details>


### [93] [Disentangling Paradigm, Identifier, and Decoding in Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08716)
*Hicham Randrianarivo,Logan Renaud,Alexia Allal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文系统对比了自回归、掩码扩散和块扩散三种生成式检索范式，在固定标识符长度和训练预算下，通过多种解码方式评估，发现解码策略对扩散模型影响极大（Hit@1 提升 6.6-13.7 分），提出的 one-pass scoring 解码在 12 个设置中 11 个优于或持平 generate-and-match；自回归模型仍领先，但优势源于模型而非束搜索；随机标识符仍能保留 83-90% 的 Hit@1，表明模型主要记忆了查询-标识符映射而非利用语义结构；产品量化标识符在自回归中优势明显，扩散模型中优势不稳定。结论强调范式对比必须在各自最佳配方和解码下进行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作在引入扩散模型时，同时改变了标识符类型、训练配方和解码策略，导致无法归因性能差异到底源于范式本身还是其他因素。本文旨在通过控制变量（固定标识符长度、训练预算），在相同数据集上公平对比自回归、掩码扩散、块扩散三种范式，并系统评估不同标识符（残差量化、产品量化、随机）和解码策略的影响，厘清各因素对检索性能的真实贡献。

Method: 在 NQ320K 和 MS300K 数据集上，分别训练自回归、掩码扩散、块扩散三类模型，使用残差量化、产品量化、随机三种标识符（长度固定）。训练预算固定。对每个模型采用多种解码方式：自回归用束搜索；扩散模型用 generate-and-match（生成标识符后检索最近语料标识符）和 one-pass scoring（单次前向传播为每个文档的码本概率打分）。评估指标为 Hit@1。

Result: 1) 解码策略对扩散模型影响巨大，Hit@1 波动 6.6-13.7 分；one-pass scoring 在 12 个设置中 11 个匹配或超越 generate-and-match。2) 自回归模型 Hit@1 仍领先，且在 NQ320K 上领先源于模型本身而非束搜索。3) 从单次采样标识符出发，one-pass scoring 消除了掩码扩散对束搜索 46-83% 的差距；从 generate-and-match 出发最多消除四分之一。4) NQ320K 上所有范式主要记忆查询-标识符映射：随机标识符保留残差量化标识符 83-90% 的 Hit@1。5) 产品量化标识符在自回归中领先残差量化 3.4 分，在扩散模型中为 -0.7 到 +3.6 分；自回归的优势差距比扩散大 1.5-2.3 分。

Conclusion: 生成式检索范式对比必须在各自最佳训练配方和最佳解码策略下进行，否则无法得出公平结论。扩散模型的性能高度依赖解码策略，one-pass scoring 是一种高效且强基线的解码方式。当前模型在大规模语料上更多表现为记忆查询-标识符映射，而非利用标识符的语义结构；标识符设计对自回归模型影响大于扩散模型。未来工作应关注如何让模型更好地利用标识符的语义结构，以及开发更强的扩散解码策略。

Abstract: Generative retrieval trains a language model to generate the identifier of a relevant document. Recent work replaces the autoregressive decoder with diffusion, but changes identifiers, training recipe and decoding at once, so differences cannot be credited to the paradigm. On NQ320K and MS300K, we train autoregressive, masked-diffusion and block-diffusion models with residual-quantised, product-quantised and random identifiers. With identifier length and training budget fixed, we decode each model in several ways. Decoding alone moves a diffusion model's Hit@1 by 6.6 to 13.7 points. Our reference diffusion decoding, generate-and-match, generates an identifier, then retrieves the closest corpus identifiers. The generated identifier is right for 14-21% of NQ320K queries. We test one-pass scoring to decode diffusion retrievers: the model reads a fully masked identifier once, and each document is scored by its codes' probabilities. It matches or beats generate-and-match in 11 of 12 settings. Autoregressive models still lead in Hit@1; on NQ320K, the lead comes from the model, not beam search. Starting from one sampled identifier, one-pass scoring removes 46-83% of masked diffusion's deficit to beam search; from generate-and-match, at most a quarter. On NQ320K, every paradigm largely memorises which identifier answers which query: random identifiers keep 83-90% of the Hit@1 of residual-quantised ones. There, product-quantised identifiers lead residual-quantised ones by 3.4 points in the autoregressive model and by -0.7 to +3.6 in diffusion models; across decodings, AR's gap exceeds diffusion's by 1.5-2.3 points, around our 2-point threshold. Paradigm comparisons must report each paradigm at its own recipe and best decoding.

</details>


### [94] [A Systematic Study of Semantic ID Spaces for Generative Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08732)
*Alexia Allal,Hicham Randrianarivo,Sylvain Lamprier*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架融合PQ和RQ量化方法，设计无训练内在指标评估DocID质量，系统研究DocID结构属性对检索效果的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式信息检索(GIR)将文档检索转为序列生成预测DocID，DocID语义设计对性能至关重要，但何为优秀DocID仍未充分探索，现有方法依赖昂贵下游评估，阻碍系统分析和快速迭代。

Method: 提出统一框架融合Product Quantization(PQ)和Residual Quantization(RQ)及其混合变体，研究层级与并行性、DocID长度、码本大小等属性；定义无训练内在指标量化DocID质量和结构保真度；在MS MARCO 300K和NQ320K上实验分析。

Result: 通过大量实验分析结构属性如何影响检索效果，验证内在指标有效性，揭示DocID设计关键权衡。

Conclusion: 统一量化框架和内在评估指标为DocID设计提供系统分析工具，加速GIR模型迭代，揭示层级与并行性、长度与码本大小等关键设计权衡。

Abstract: Generative Information Retrieval (GIR) has emerged as a transformative paradigm, shifting document retrieval from a traditional "retrieve-and-rank" workflow to sequence-to-sequence generation, where a model directly predicts document identifiers (DocIDs). While the semantic design of these DocIDs is known to be critical for performance, a fundamental question remains under-explored: what makes a good DocID? Current approaches rely heavily on computationally expensive downstream evaluations, hindering systematic analysis and rapid iteration. In this work, we address this challenge by presenting a comprehensive study on the properties, metrics, and trade-offs that define effective numerical DocIDs. Specifically, our contributions are threefold: First, we propose a unified framework that unifies Product Quantization (PQ) and Residual Quantization (RQ), and their hybrid variants within a single design space. This enables us to systematically study key DocID properties, such as hierarchy versus parallelism, as well as the impact of hyperparameters like DocID length and codebook size. Second, we define a suite of training-free, intrinsic metrics, to quantify DocID quality and evaluate structural fidelity without the overhead of full model training. Through extensive experiments on MS MARCO 300K and NQ320K, we analyze how these structural properties influence retrieval effectiveness.

</details>

### [95] [GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06910)
*Haoyue Yang,Jingyao Li,Zhengfan Wu,Jing Liu,Xuanle Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GameGo 框架，将简短游戏种子转化为完整的产品需求文档（PRD），利用任务特定的动态压缩保留核心约束并最大化信息密度，构建了包含 55,060 条开发轨迹的 GameGoData 和 124 个查询的 GameGoBench，训练得到的 GameGoCoder 在游戏开发基准上超越同规模基线并接近前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的网页前端执行和游戏生成方法多依赖复杂的多轮工作流或静态评测基准，直接从稀疏用户查询生成复杂游戏会导致编码代理做出欠规范假设，产生不完整机制、脱节玩法流程和有限视觉美感。因此需要一种系统化框架将简短种子扩展为符合行业实践的完整 PRD，以保留核心玩法约束并支持设计探索。

Method: GameGo 框架包含两大核心组件：(1) 可扩展的 PRD 生成管道，将游戏种子转化为综合产品需求文档，采用任务特定的动态压缩技术在保持指令遵循能力的同时最大化信息密度；(2) 基于此管道构建 GameGoData（55,060 条涵盖 2D、2.5D、3D 游戏的开发轨迹）和 GameGoBench（124 个多样化游戏查询基准）。在此数据上训练 GameGoCoder 模型。

Result: 在游戏开发基准测试中，GameGoCoder 超越了匹配规模的基线模型，并与前沿模型性能相当。所有代码、数据集和模型将公开发布。

Conclusion: GameGo 通过系统化的 PRD 生成和动态压缩策略，有效解决了从稀疏查询直接生成复杂游戏的欠规范问题，构建的大规模数据集和基准推动了端到端游戏合成研究，训练得到的模型在游戏开发任务上达到前沿水平，为编码代理驱动的真实游戏合成提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [96] [Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06914)
*Yiou Wu,Zezhi Tang,Ningwei Bai,Liuhaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Text2Dashboard是一个DataBrain专用原型系统，将自然语言分析请求转换为可检查的仪表板。系统结合Codex插件和Agent Runtime，利用模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久化状态和确定性Hooks实现审批、审计、检查点、恢复和故障处理。评估显示在冻结的真实DataBrain任务上，严格成功率为6/8，故障场景全部符合预期结果，但结果规模较小，未证明生产就绪性或通用text-to-SQL准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决自然语言到仪表板生成的可靠性、可审计性和可控性问题，特别是在企业级数据分析场景中，需要强制执行只读SQL、实体解析、元数据发现、静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查等安全机制，同时提供确定性的执行控制和状态记录。

Method: 采用Codex插件和独立Agent Runtime架构，结合模式约束的模型决策与类型化工具、持久化状态和确定性Hooks。流水线包括实体解析、元数据发现、只读SQL强制执行、仪表板组合、静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查。模型提出动作，确定性软件控制执行并记录状态转换。

Result: 在冻结的真实DataBrain任务评估中：元数据选择4/4通过，所有4个SQL任务满足语义标准，2/4满足精确输出列合同；最终版本通过4/4单面板仪表板任务、1个双面板任务和1个现有仪表板优化任务；1个参数化任务超出步数限制。所有10个故障场景均满足指定结果且无未批准外部副作用。模型推理占运行时97%以上。

Conclusion: Text2Dashboard在DataBrain特定任务上展示了可行性，故障处理机制有效，但由于评估规模小且特定于DataBrain，不能确立生产就绪性、通用text-to-SQL准确性或相对于手工仪表板构建的效率优势。

Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

</details>


### [97] [FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06917)
*Kartik Ramesh,Kaidi Fu,Zihan Zheng,Jiahuan Yu,Fabio Oliveira,Carlos Costa,Minjia Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FluidPD是一种预填-解码分离的服务系统，通过就地弹性机制解决预填和解码阶段的负载不平衡问题，显著提升SLO达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预填-解码分离系统采用固定的工作比例，无法应对真实负载中短时突发和持续变化的预填/解码需求比例，导致SLO违规；自动扩缩容反应慢、需要备用GPU，且不能解决短时间尺度的阶段不平衡。

Method: 提出FluidToken和FluidRole两种互补机制：FluidToken在解码侧有闲置时将部分预填计算卸载到解码工作器，处理短时不平衡；FluidRole通过就地重新分配运行中的工作器在预填和解码角色间切换，避免模型重载和引擎重启，处理持续不平衡。两者均由轻量级压力指数指导，提前暴露资源压力。

Result: 在生产级Azure追踪负载下，FluidPD相比静态SGLang将整体SLO达成率提升高达94.6个百分点。

Conclusion: SLO感知的就地预填/解码弹性机制能在不增加额外工作器的情况下显著提升服务质量。

Abstract: Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance.
  We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

</details>


### [98] [Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06919)
*Akash Kannan,Kiho Park,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Anchor Divergences方法，通过锚点分布建模来定义上下文相关的语义几何，使对比学习的固定表示能适应不同语义相似性需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统余弦相似度提供单一固定几何，但语义相似性本质上依赖上下文（如相同物体、视觉风格、临床发现等）。需要一种方法在固定表示上动态指定上下文特定的语义几何。

Method: 结合对比学习、指数族分布和信息几何，建立锚点概率分布与表示空间上Bregman几何的对应关系。通过建模锚点分布来建模几何本身，定义Anchor Divergences作为上下文特定语义几何的度量。

Result: 检索实验表明，Anchor Divergences能有效高效地指定上下文特定的语义相似性，优于固定几何方法。

Conclusion: 对比表示自然包含可特化为特定语义结构的几何族，锚点分布建模提供了灵活高效的上下文相关语义相似度计算框架。

Abstract: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

</details>


### [99] [RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06923)
*Caiwen Jiang,Shuoyang Wei,Songlin Zhao,Junyu Li,Jingyuan Chen,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RadOnc-Agent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理式AI框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段，提供26个可调用函数，通过对话式接口协调异构放疗能力与纵向工作流信息。实验表明系统在单函数选择、跨阶段合成场景及真实患者工作流上均实现>96%完成率；消融实验证实纵向状态保持与模式/身份验证对跨阶段协调至关重要。研究确立了LLM编排架构在技术层面的可行性，但未验证临床正确性、效用或前瞻获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前放疗领域的AI能力分散于不同临床阶段、软件环境和数据模态，与从决策到随访的纵向放疗工作流形成对比。亟需一种统一框架，能在保持患者与工作流上下文的前提下，跨阶段协调异构能力与信息。

Method: 构建RadOnc-Agent框架：(1) 将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，定义26个可调用函数；(2) 采用LLM控制器将临床意图映射为模式约束的函数调用，保持患者与工作流上下文，并路由至专用后端服务；(3) 通过三层评估体系验证：2,600次单函数请求（7,800次重复执行）、200个预设合成跨阶段场景（600次执行）、来自60例去标识化患者记录的120个工作流实例（360次净执行），覆盖决策到规划及规划到适应两大流程；(4) 开展消融实验，分别移除纵向状态、禁用模式与身份验证，量化其对跨阶段完成率与后端调度匹配度的影响。

Result: 单函数执行中意图函数选择准确率98.79%；预设跨阶段工作流完成率96.50%；真实患者工作流完成率96.67%。消融实验显示：移除纵向状态导致跨阶段完成率从96.50%降至84.00%；禁用模式与身份验证使后端调度错配率从0%升至95.28%（回放/测试评估）。

Conclusion: 研究在技术层面确立了LLM编排架构协调异构放疗能力与纵向工作流信息的可行性，证明了纵向状态保持与模式验证对跨阶段协作的关键作用。但作者明确指出：结果未确立临床正确性、临床效用或前瞻临床获益，后续仍需前瞻性临床验证。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

</details>


### [100] [Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06928)
*Jing Ding,Ziqiao Ma,Jiayuan Mao,Joyce Chai,Freda Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉Transformer如何在缺乏直接指称证据的情况下 grounding 抽象概念（如「愤怒」），提出并验证了「转喻 grounding 机制」：抽象预测由具体的、可解释的锚点概念（如「火」）驱动，这些锚点连接视觉信号与抽象语义。通过在CLIP和DINO编码器上应用Transcoder恢复中间特征，在精心策划的图标数据集上发现结构化的转喻电路：早期层以感知基元为主，对象级锚点先于抽象目标出现；含渲染文本的图像则走独立的感知到文本路径。因果干预进一步确认了转喻中介在抽象概念 grounding 中的功能性作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究较少探讨视觉Transformer在训练数据缺乏直接指称证据时如何 grounding 抽象概念。作者假设存在一种转喻 grounding 机制：抽象概念的预测并非直接从像素学习，而是通过具体的、可解释的锚点概念（如「火」代表「愤怒」）作为中介，将视觉信号桥接到抽象语义。

Method: 1. 在CLIP和DINO视觉编码器上应用Transcoder（一种稀疏自编码器变体），恢复可关联具体概念语义标签的中间特征。2. 追踪这些特征在抽象概念识别底层电路中的贡献。3. 在精心策划的图标数据集上实验，对比纯图标与含渲染文本图像的处理路径差异。4. 进行因果干预实验，验证转喻中介的功能性必要性。

Result: 发现结构化的转喻电路：感知基元主导早期层，对象级锚点概念在抽象目标之前激活；含渲染文本的图像招募独立的「感知→文本」路径而非对象锚点路径。因果干预证实移除或改变转喻中介特征会显著降低抽象概念预测性能，确认其功能性参与。

Conclusion: 视觉Transformer通过转喻机制 grounding 抽象概念：具体锚点概念作为可解释的中介桥接视觉信号与抽象语义。该机制在层级上呈现感知基元→对象锚点→抽象目标的顺序结构，且对文本渲染图像存在独立处理路径。这为理解大规模视觉模型的抽象推理提供了机制性解释。

Abstract: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

</details>


### [101] [Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06964)
*Bowen Ye,Yongchao Xu,Junkai Ma,Xiang Yin,Wenzhao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGA 框架通过将交互轨迹抽象为分层知识（情景描述、可复用程序、带适用条件的原则），并建立执行-抽象反馈闭环，使 LLM 智能体能在不修改参数的情况下持续进化，在 ScienceWorld 和 ALFWorld 上显著提升任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体难以从经验中持续进化；微调依赖参数访问且计算成本高；外部记忆方法虽避免修改参数，但获取的知识与特定任务/上下文强耦合，泛化能力有限。核心挑战是如何将具体交互转化为抽象可复用的知识以指导未来决策。

Method: 提出 SAGA 框架：(1) 将交互轨迹渐进转化为情景描述、可复用程序、带显式适用条件的原则，并保留执行证据链接；(2) 检索原则并实例化为任务特定指导，通过纠正性反馈和重采样细化候选动作；(3) 形成执行-抽象反馈闭环，累积知识指导未来交互，新经验持续更新分层记忆。

Result: 在 ScienceWorld 和 ALFWorld 基准上任务性能显著提升；消融实验表明情境化实例化和动作调控对利用原则级知识至关重要。

Conclusion: SAGA 通过经验落地的知识抽象与利用，实现了无需参数微调的 LLM 智能体持续自我进化，验证了分层抽象记忆与执行-抽象闭环对泛化能力的关键作用。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

</details>


### [102] [AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06971)
*Muhammad Bilal Awan,Zubair Hussain,Abdul Shahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AegisFlow，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能自愈框架，通过 Watchdog 代理收集遥测数据和 Repair 代理自动生成、测试、部署代码补丁，结合 MAPE-K 循环的 Parallel Shadow Patching 非侵入式执行模型，在数字孪生环境中验证补丁，实现了数据管道故障的自动化检测与修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据管道因上游模式漂移、API 契约变更、网站 DOM 修改等极易失效，现有可观测性工具仅能告警依赖人工干预，导致平均修复时间（MTTR）高、运维疲劳严重，亟需实现从检测到修复的闭环自动化。

Method: AegisFlow 包含 Watchdog 代理（运行时遥测收集）和 Repair 代理（基于 LLM 自动生成、测试、部署补丁）；采用 Parallel Shadow Patching 非侵入式执行模型，基于 MAPE-K 循环在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁，支持以插件形式无缝集成到现有管道编排系统。

Result: 在五种常见故障场景实验中，MTTR 平均从 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟（提升 98.1%），补丁成功率 92%；JSON 模式变更成功率 96%，标点漂移 98%，Shadow DOM 场景最低 85%；释放约 98% 数据工程值班时间用于创新。

Conclusion: AegisFlow 通过 Agentic 智能体与 MAPE-K 闭环实现了数据管道故障的自动化自愈，大幅降低 MTTR 和运维负担，具备部署无关性且易于集成，为数据工程运维提供了可落地的智能化解决方案。

Abstract: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

</details>


### [103] [EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06986)
*Binjie Guo,Aisheng Mo,Ruitong Li,Xinle Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 EPOCH，一种基于证据治理的 AI 研究代理架构，通过显式任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查和独立重放，实现证据治理的发现闭环，在 AlgoTune、Math14、AgentHPO 等基准上达到最优性能，并在十个发现问题上取得实质性进展，证明证据治理是通往可信科学发现的必要步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 研究代理在搜索程序、数学构造和证明时，仅优化评估器反馈，缺乏对反馈解释、质疑和复用的治理机制，导致脆弱候选被误判为发现，基准提升、有限证书与定理级声明混淆，亟需一种能依据声明强度与范围评估候选的证据治理框架。

Method: EPOCH 实现证据治理的发现循环，包含五大核心组件：显式任务契约（明确任务目标与验收标准）、类型化记忆（结构化存储证据与元数据）、主动证伪（主动寻找反例与边界情况）、准入检查（依据证据强度准入候选）、独立重放（第三方复现验证），确保每个候选都依据其支撑声明的证据强度与范围被评估。

Result: 在 AlgoTune 上平均归一化得分 0.65（基线 0.53）达 SOTA；在内部 Math14 套件平均得分 0.57 最高；在官方测试重放下展现良好泛化；在 AgentHPO 描述性聚合指标领先；跨十个发现问题给出改进的可执行构造、优化算法、反例及证明支持的结果，展现将搜索转化为实质进展的能力。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，证据治理是构建不仅能产出更强解决方案，更能生成可信科学发现的 AI 研究代理的必要步骤，EPOCH 为此提供了可行的架构范式。

Abstract: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

</details>


### [104] [When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06992)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过分层诊断研究揭示了交通预测精度提升不一定能带来更好的信号控制决策，指出预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动力学一致性和目标对齐性四个关键因素，并提出了一个实用的诊断协议来识别预测改进未能转化为运营收益的环节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管交通流预测技术不断进步，但预测精度的提升往往不能直接转化为信号控制性能的改善。现有研究缺乏系统性的诊断框架来量化预测改进与控制决策之间的差距，以及识别导致这种“预测-控制鸿沟”的具体机制。

Method: 基于中国宣城29天重构需求数据（7天测试），构建分层诊断框架：评估点预测、共形预测区间、依赖感知场景及匹配闭环控制器；审计决策时刻接口泄露与有效动作可识别性；修正时序接口，对比因果预测与5秒事件预言机，采用穷举联合动作搜索；引入合成阳性对照验证未来信息的潜在价值；使用配对日自助法进行统计推断。

Result: 入口级和车道级预测分别将MAE降低4.03%和3.92%；名义90%共形区间边际覆盖率达90.72%，但高需求子集仅75.66%；仅2/9路口存在多个有效控制动作；合成阳性对照显示未来信息可降低内部推演成本61.5%；但在冻结测试日，因果预测和预言机分别使排队车秒数增加6.09%和3.39%，预言机虽减少溢流暴露3.78%，但自助法置信区间跨零，统计不显著。

Conclusion: 预测价值不仅取决于预测精度，更受制于时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动力学一致性和目标对齐性。提出的分层诊断协议能系统性地定位预测改进失效的环节，为交通信号控制中的预测驱动决策提供了务实的评估范式。

Abstract: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

</details>


### [105] [Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06995)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过冻结协议评估更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖是否能改善路径决策。使用北京和成都的道路速度数据构建离线代理任务，发现联合校准上界虽显著提升了联合覆盖率（北京M1从83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1从75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2从74.01%升至90.64%），但反而增加了迟到率和平均通行时间；而速度平均绝对误差降低14.91%则伴随迟到率下降1.4571个百分点。结论：联合覆盖率不是下游路径效用的替代指标，离线结果无法确立在线或因果收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前不清楚更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖是否真能改善实际路径决策，需要将预测质量指标与下游决策效用解耦并实证检验。

Method: 采用冻结协议将速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖、路径选择和实现损失分离。使用北京和成都的处理后道路速度数据，构建包含150个OD对、3条候选路径、每城市14个测试日的离线代理任务。对比原始90分位路径时间上界与最小上界路径选择下的联合校准上界。

Result: 联合覆盖率显著提升：北京M1从83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1从75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2从74.01%升至90.64%。但C2指标下迟到率分别增加0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均通行时间分别增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。成都预测器对比中，速度MAE降低14.91%伴随C0下迟到率降低1.4571个百分点。

Conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不是下游路径效用的替代指标；离线实验结果无法确立在线部署或因果层面的收益。

Abstract: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

</details>


### [106] [Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07004)
*Sen Zhao,Jia Tang,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Ding Zou,Xinyu He,Xu Zhang,Junwei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoPlanner，一种拓扑一致的规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形，通过余层一致的细胞检索和多维结构推理，使 LLM 能生成包含验证-修正循环、收敛分支合并及可复用中间状态的复杂工具序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 规划器在顺序或有向无环图（DAG）结构上表现良好，但难以处理真实工具编排中自然出现的验证-修正循环、收敛分支合并和可复用中间状态等工作流模式。

Method: TopoPlanner 将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形，通过余层一致的细胞检索获取请求相关的闭子复形，在检索到的拓扑上执行多维结构推理，并将生成的细胞表示与规划 LLM 接口以生成工具序列。

Result: 在四个包含拓扑引导的循环、合并及循环-合并工作流的工具规划基准上，TopoPlanner 在不同本地 LLM 主干上均优于基于提示和图增强的基线方法。

Conclusion: 将工具依赖建模为细胞复形并利用拓扑感知推理，能有效解决 LLM 代理在复杂工作流模式（循环、合并、可复用状态）下的规划难题，提供了一种通用的拓扑一致规划范式。

Abstract: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

</details>


### [107] [When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07018)
*Ziquan Zhu,Hanruo Zhu,Si-Yuan Lu,Morris Yu-Chao Huang,Yicheng Lin,Wei Han,Tianlong Chen,Mingyuan Wu,Hanchao Yu,Gaojie Jin,Lu Liu,Bo Sun,Tianjin Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MOTIVE框架，通过多视角自我验证和可靠性引导的选择性重思考，提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的多模态推理可靠性，无需外部评判器即可实现更可靠高效的自我验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在多模态推理中表现强劲，但容易生成看似合理却错误的答案。自我验证虽能无需外部评判器提升可靠性，但现有方法依赖单一验证标准或固定提示词，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。系统分析发现：更强的验证器提供更可靠判断，而验证性能对提示词选择高度敏感，无单一提示词在所有任务中持续占优。

Method: MOTIVE包含三个核心组件：1）多视角验证：从互补验证角度评估每个候选答案；2）正确性对齐的可靠性学习：通过基于正确性的多视角验证学习，获得与正确性对齐的可靠性分数；3）推理时的接受或重思考决策：可靠性分数决定直接返回可靠答案，或触发基于历史的重思考机制处理不确定答案。

Result: 在多样化的多模态基准和VLM骨干网络上进行的大量实验表明，MOTIVE持续超越强自我验证和自我修正基线。进一步结果显示，可靠的验证改善了接受或重思考的决策，减少了不必要的推理轮次。

Conclusion: MOTIVE实现了无需外部评判器的更可靠、更高效的自我验证，为多模态推理的可信度提升提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

</details>


### [108] [Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07023)
*Jinghao Pang,Jitai Hao,Qiang Huang,Zhaochun Ren,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SSRFT（Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning），将安全对齐重构为安全角色的内化，通过构建安全角色问答数据集（SRQA）使模型学习安全价值观而非单纯拒绝模式，实现更鲁棒、泛化性更强的安全对齐，同时减少过度拒绝并保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）依赖大量攻击特定监督和算力，易导致浅层安全对齐和过度拒绝，且对越狱攻击鲁棒性不足。

Method: SSRFT 从心理测量问题、有限越狱提示和安全角色描述构建 SRQA 数据集，合成角色一致的回答，经验证后扩展至多样场景，使模型内化安全导向的价值观与原则，而非显式拒绝模式。

Result: 在多个基础模型和指令模型上实验表明，SSRFT 相比标准 SFT 实现了更鲁棒、泛化性更强的安全对齐：对预填充攻击鲁棒性显著提升，对未见越狱领域泛化更好，减少良性查询的过度拒绝，并保持模型通用能力。

Conclusion: 安全角色内化是以拒绝为中心的安全对齐的有效替代方案，能以较低监督成本实现更本质、泛化的安全对齐。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

</details>


### [109] [Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07091)
*Abbas Raza Ali,Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui,Moona Zahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套生产级内容提取系统，解决生成式AI时代企业异构文档（PDF、表格、扫描件等）的感知层问题，通过选择性OCR路由、基于参考的评分器、结构感知分块器和仅读检索评估器，实现了高精度的字符/表格提取（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）和检索效果（Hit@1 68.6%，MRR 0.77），并总结了三条设计原则：结构先于语义、不修改被测量对象、为标注预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI将模型与任务解耦，导致企业知识以多模态、异构格式存在（文本、视觉、几何、结构混合）。现有语言模型或检索器无法可靠推理在该接口被错误表征的信息，内容提取成为独立的生命周期阶段，其错误无法由下游检索器或重排器修复，因此需要显式、可配置、可度量的提取系统。

Method: 系统包含四大核心组件：1) 选择性OCR路由，根据文档特征动态决定是否调用OCR；2) 稀缺优先策展引擎与基于参考的提取评分器，在字符、词、表格结构三级测量准确率；3) 确定性结构感知父子分块器，保留文档层级结构；4) 仅读检索评估器，从每页生成 grounded 问题，报告 Hit@k、MRR 和延迟。

Result: 在180文档语料上，最佳提取器得分97.4/100（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到 Hit@1 68.6%、Hit@10 92.8%、MRR 0.77。系统验证了三条设计原则的有效性。

Conclusion: 将度量化的内容提取定位为企业智能体系统的感知层，强调结构先于语义、不修改被测量对象、为标注预算三大原则，为构建可靠的企业级RAG和智能体系统提供了可复现的工程基础设施。

Abstract: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

</details>


### [110] [Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07026)
*Sunday Afariogun,Odunolaoluwa Jenrola,Zeinab Nezami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

</details>


### [111] [JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07036)
*Sara Abdali,Pashmina Cameron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 JIVEAdapter，一种多任务低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的 Joint 结构和任务特定的 Individual 结构，通过正交约束保持共享与任务特有信号的可解释分离，并自适应分配秩预算。Joint 仅学习一次（联合或增量），随后冻结复用作新任务的先验，无需额外模块即在 GLUE/SuperGLUE 上达到强基线水平，且对新任务仅需微调极小的 Individual 或仅做逐方向缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法多为单任务、乘法式低秩适配器，缺乏对跨任务共享与任务特有成分的显式建模，导致难以复用共享知识、且共享/特有信号混淆不可解释。

Method: 基于统计学 JIVE 思想，将每层权重增量 ΔW 分解为 Joint（跨任务共享低秩矩阵）与 Individual（各任务专属低秩矩阵）的加法组合；对 Individual 施加正交惩罚使其与 Joint 近正交，保证共享与特有信号分离；引入自适应秩分配机制在 Joint 池与 Individual 池间动态分配秩预算。Joint 在任务组上联合或增量学习一次后冻结，作为新任务的先验复用。

Result: 在 DeBERTaV3-base 上，以相同的任务级有效秩，JIVEAdapter 在 GLUE 与 SuperGLUE 基准上与强单任务/多任务低秩基线持平，且未使用 MoE 等额外模块。当存在相关 held-in 任务时，冻结的 Joint 配合该任务的 Individual 仅通过廉价的逐方向缩放即可服务 held-out 任务；否则仅需训练一个很小的新 Individual。

Conclusion: JIVEAdapter 通过显式的 Joint/Individual 分解与正交约束，实现了可解释的共享-特有分离与高效的跨任务知识复用，在保持参数效率的同时达到强基线性能，为多任务低秩适配提供了新范式。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

</details>


### [112] [The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07309)
*Zi Wang,Xingqiao Wang,Emmanuel Addai,Devika Ambekar,Xiaowei Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种检索可采纳性验证框架，用于解决长期记忆代理在检索时可能获取不可采纳信息（属于其他主体、违反策略或生命周期状态不兼容）的问题。现有的召回率和最终答案准确率指标无法揭示此类问题。该框架为每个记忆-查询对分配三种状态（可采纳、不可采纳、未解决），在匹配所需证据召回率下比较路由，跟踪记忆ID通过提示暴露并关联到目标级披露。在RHELM和MemOps两个基准上的评估显示，Top-20锚点召回率从0.432提升至0.533，80%召回可行性从0.237提升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%。结果支持对候选支持、可采纳性、提示暴露和答案披露进行单独验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆代理在检索时可能获取不可采纳的信息（如属于其他主体、违反策略、生命周期状态不兼容），但现有的召回率和最终答案准确率指标无法揭示这一问题：路由可能因遗漏所需证据而显得安全，而正确答案可能源于不可采纳的提示暴露。因此需要一种框架来单独验证候选支持、可采纳性、提示暴露和答案披露。

Method: 提出检索可采纳性验证框架：1) 为每个记忆-查询对分配三种状态（可采纳、不可采纳、未解决）；2) 在匹配所需证据召回率下比较路由，并为未解决情况提供边界；3) 跟踪记忆ID通过提示暴露，并将暴露关联到目标级披露。评估方法包括：在独立非合并人群上分阶段评估；对RHELM和MemOps基准的冻结排名进行事后Top-20重分析（覆盖3,767个查询）；72例冻结开发诊断；1,523个配对基准原生案例的命名空间路由分析；16个受控暴露场景实验。

Result: 1) 所有发布的锚点均位于受信任查询命名空间内，命名空间内分数不变时，域外过滤无法降低其排名；2) Top-20锚点召回率从0.432提升至0.533，80%召回可行性从0.237提升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%；3) 72例诊断中，发布的元数据参考保留了所需证据，而两个纯文本验证器均未在1%所需锚点误拒绝限制下检测到违规；4) 1,523个配对案例中，命名空间路由与三个阅读者的判断准确率增益0.053-0.068相关（观察性比较）；5) 16个受控暴露场景中，仅四个阅读者特定的95%置信区间之一排除了零，相关不可采纳字面披露为+0.156 (95% CI [0.031, 0.312])。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，现有指标无法捕捉不可采纳信息检索问题，验证了提出框架的有效性。结果强烈支持对候选支持、可采纳性、提示暴露和答案披露进行单独验证，以确保长期记忆代理的安全性和合规性。

Abstract: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure. We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.

</details>


### [113] [Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07037)
*Qurat-ul-ain,Yee Whye Teh,Charlotte M. Deane,Matteo Cagiada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练、模型无关的后处理方法，通过两个闭式投影算子（分子间范德华投影和配体距离几何投影）在推理阶段修正AlphaFold 3风格扩散模型生成的结构，实现完美的物理有效性且不损失结构准确性，开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlphaFold 3风格的共折叠模型虽结构准确度高，但输出常含物理无效问题（链重叠、配体几何扭曲、环非平面、手性反转）。现有方法要么引入物理势能增加采样成本，要么微调模型耗时且依赖架构。作者发现物理有效性可在推理时从采样器已有量验证，故将其视为约束推理问题。

Method: 提出两个作用于扩散模型去噪坐标估计$¥hat{x}_0$的闭式投影算子：(1) 分子间范德华投影，推开严重碰撞的原子对；(2) 配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性和手性。算子局部、稀疏、位移有上限，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不改动去噪器权重，可即插即用于任何AF3风格采样器。

Result: 在Boltz-2和OpenFold-3两个独立模型上，跨五个基准测试（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体/复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集），方法恢复完美物理有效性，同时保持结构准确度和配体放置指标，运行时和内存开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一条实用、模型无关的路径，以极小开销实现物理有效的全原子结构预测，解决了AF3风格模型推理后物理无效的核心痛点。

Abstract: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

</details>


### [114] [ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07886)
*Miao Xie,Xiao Zhang,Yuan Wang,Ruixin Zhu,Chunli Lv*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题(MDP)，并开发营养智能体'善量人'(ShanLiangRen)，结合精确检索增强生成与帕累托引导的LLM迭代优化，输出含具体食材份量的全量化食谱及营养合规报告，已上线微信小程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 膳食营养规划在慢病管理和健康维护中至关重要，但需同时满足个性化约束与多维营养目标，二者常冲突且用户约束随反馈演变，导致通用指南与可执行计划存在巨大鸿沟。

Method: 1) 将膳食规范、营养数据、用户属性及自然语言需求转化为个性化约束规划实例；2) 采用精确检索增强生成从大规模食材菜谱空间压缩可行候选集；3) 基于帕累托原则迭代优化，LLM在确定性营养计算与约束验证反馈下修订候选方案。

Result: 系统输出含明确食材与份量的全量化膳食计划，附带营养合规报告展示约束满足度与营养素区间达成情况；已发布微信小程序'善量人'并提供演示视频。

Conclusion: 通过将MDP形式化并融合检索增强生成与帕累托引导的LLM优化，该系统有效弥合了通用膳食指南与个性化可执行计划之间的差距，实现了多目标约束下的精准膳食规划。

Abstract: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space.
